body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Macally(www.macally.com) unveiled USB 2.0 web-cam 'Megacam' with built-in microphone at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
'Megacam' is convenient because it doesn't need to install driver thanks to plug-and-play USB 2.0. Angle of view is 180˚ and 1600x1200 resolution with maximum 30 frames. The price is 39.99USD.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
